d: Straight, shoulder-length auburn hair with blunt-cut bangs across the forehead. Small, narrow auburn eyes with a stern expression on a youthful, teenage face. A slender build wearing a khaki military-style sailor dress with a dark olive green collar and skirt, featuring a dark brown necktie, white stripes on the sleeves, and two large pockets on the front. The outfit is paired with mechanical gray gun-turret equipment attached to the arms and waist.
